title: Romanian prosecutors indict alleged financier of Călin Georgescu’s TikTok campaign for voter bribery
summary: Bogdan Peșchir, described by prosecutors as a financier of Călin Georgescu’s TikTok campaign, has been indicted on charges of voter bribery. He will remain free pending trial, and the case has been sent to the Brașov Court, local news agency Agerpres reported. The General Prosecutor’s Office accused Peșchir of 874 individual acts committed as part of a continued offence between October 13 and November 27, 2024. According to the indictment, Bogdan Peșchir allegedly provided benefits worth a total of USD 290,225 to persuade voters to support Russia-friendly independent candidate Călin Georgescu in the 2024 presidential election.
